syn-agreement: Designers, generated interfaces: Krippendorff's α 0.25, 25% of the way from 0 (chance) to 1 (perfect). 20 people with design training judged the same 600 pairs of generated interfaces (Peng and colleagues, a 2026 preprint).
syn-four-components: Simulation of a model, not data. Acquisition order (EUBO), a week after the session. Across 24 simulated people, the final design is still preferred over early-rejected designs 88% of the time at the end of the session and 78% a week later under acquisition order, against 76% and 73% under randomized order.
theory-rates: With the Matérn 5/2 kernel and lengthscale 0.1, the greedy estimate of the maximum information gain after 1000 rounds is 42.6. With constants set to 1, γ_T √T is 1346 and √(γ_T T) is 206, against T = 1000; the two differ by the factor √γ_T = 6.5.
